name: @hzlmy2002/web-market

tools.name: AIsa_similar_sites
tools.description: Find similar website candidates for one domain. Returns domain, affinity and rank; similarity is not proof of a business competitor. Requires the latest supported end_month; fetches exactly three months. Up to 20 candidates. Use traffic_engagement for subsequent comparison. Billed AIsa API call.

end_month.description: Latest supported month for Similar Sites. Requests exactly this month and the two preceding months.

max_price_usd.description: Optional TOTAL USD ceiling for this tool invocation, split across its planned API calls.

tools.name: AIsa_traffic_engagement
tools.description: Compare 1–5 domains over the SAME explicit monthly window (1–12 months), country and total web scope. Returns aligned visits, pages/visit, duration seconds, bounce-rate fractions, missing values and endpoint growth. Estimates, not first-party analytics. No cross-period averaging of rates. Billed once per domain.

max_price_usd.description: Optional TOTAL USD ceiling for this tool invocation, split across its planned API calls.

tools.name: AIsa_geography
tools.description: Fetch latest available worldwide traffic geography for 1–5 domains, at most 10 countries per domain. Returns country shares, visits and reported dates. Dates may differ between domains; no historical or country filter. Use only when geography is requested. Billed once per domain.

max_price_usd.description: Optional TOTAL USD ceiling for this tool invocation, split across its planned API calls.

tools.name: AIsa_website_keywords
tools.description: Read one website keyword sample for an explicit month, US or worldwide. At most 20 keywords with clicks, traffic share, position, intent and top URL when available. The API does not expose organic/nonbranded filters or volume/difficulty; do not infer them. For comparing sites use keyword_gap. Billed API call.

max_price_usd.description: Optional TOTAL USD ceiling for this tool invocation, split across its planned API calls.

tools.name: AIsa_keyword_gap
tools.description: Compare one target and 1–3 competitors using same-month, same-country keyword samples (max 20/site). Returns per-site evidence and deterministic position classes. competitor_only_in_sample means absent from a successful target SAMPLE, not no rankings. No organic/nonbranded filter, volume or difficulty guarantee. Does not generate content strategy. Billed once per domain.

max_price_usd.description: Optional TOTAL USD ceiling for this tool invocation, split across its planned API calls.

instructions: Website competitive analysis using five AIsa tools. Use the installed aisa-web-market skill for scenario guidance. Compare identical scope and preserve missing-data evidence. API calls are billed. Credentials come from local OAuth login or AISA_API_KEY. If authentication fails, ask the user to run setup in their terminal; never request credentials or callback URLs in conversation.
